purpose: Describe conditional total taxon-resolution PPR scenarios, not estimate an identified true correction.

state.groups: signed-review default exclusions retained, original allocation weights never renormalized
state.taxon_TL: 1+log10(saved simple coefficient), previously reconciled to current Classic PPR Taxa

transport_definition.anchored_taxon_coefficient: s_ig(b)=S_g * 10**(b*(T_i-T_g)); different mapped groups retain their own anchors
assumptions: The fitted between-group TL relation is assumed to transport within a functional group, although this is untested.
Each taxon retains its group-specific multiplicative residual/efficiency/feedback factor.
Diet, network structure, GE/EE, catch allocations and source decomposition are not recomputed; no finer food web is constructed.
Reference taxon TL and effective model TL are treated as comparable despite different source/definition conventions.
transport_definition.not_a_confidence_interval: The scenario spread and leave-one-model-out range are sensitivity analyses, not calibrated uncertainty bounds for true PPR.

retransformation.log_regression_estimand: A log-linear fit describes conditional log SPPR/geometric location, not automatically arithmetic mean SPPR.
retransformation.anchored_identity: If log10 S_g=a_model+b*T_g+e_g, anchoring gives log10 s_ig=a_model+b*T_i+e_g. Each observed group residual is retained.
retransformation.smearing: No extra smearing multiplier is applied. Multiplying anchored estimates by a fitted residual smearing factor would count the same observed group heterogeneity again. Unknown new within-group residual variation remains unidentified.
retransformation.expectation: The arithmetic sum over observed catch taxa is exact under the stipulated anchored coefficients. It is not an identified expectation over unobserved true taxon coefficients.
